column2: I do agree with you that our Jira workflow is very simplistic and needs to be matured
You are right that the current workflow does not give the test team the flexibility and responsibilities that you need.
We want to mature SE as a product and to get there we also need to mature our processes
so I think this is a good time to make some of these changes
The existing workflow was very simple in part because I needed to get everyone on the development team using it
Some are harder to encourage than others
The workflow also needs to cater for managing the development of new features
so it’s important that we get the balance right that works for both teams.
I have drawn out the existing workflow and then drawn a possible new workflow that we could move to
Please refer to the attached document (either in PDF or in Keynote format)
The new workflow gives the test team better visibility of issues that need to be actioned as well as the responsibility for validating fixes and acknowledging/closing bugs
the development team will work on issues from the Backlog and issues will end up in one of the 3 green states
